meta.title: About — SendMe
meta.description: Discover SendMe, the international money transfer platform: our mission, our values and our key figures.

hero.title: Sending money should never be complicated
hero.subtitle: SendMe is an international money transfer platform designed to be fast, transparent and accessible to everyone, wherever you are in the world.

mission.title: Rethinking money transfers
mission.p1: Born from a final year project combining technical innovation and business rigor, SendMe aims to radically simplify the experience of sending money to Africa and beyond.
mission.p2: We believe sending money to your loved ones should be as simple as sending a message: a few seconds, a clear rate and no surprises. That is the promise we carry every day.
